REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL AND OPERATING RESULTS FRISCO, TEXAS, November 4, 2026 – Comstock Resources, Inc. ("Comstock" or the "Company") (NYSE; NYSE Texas: CRK) today reported financial and operating results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Highlights of 2026 's Third Quarter • Production grew 9% from the third quarter of 2025 and was 8% higher than the second quarter of 2026 driven by our drilling program. • Sixteen Legacy Haynesville wells were turned to sales with an average lateral length of 10,812 feet and an average per well initial production rate of 25 MMcf per day. Six of these wells were horseshoe wells. • Six Western Haynesville wells were turned to sales in the third quarter with an average lateral length of 9,829 feet and an average per well initial production rate of 33 MMcf per day. • Growth in production drove the third quarter 2026 financial results: • Natural gas and oil sales, including realized hedging gains, increased to $359 million for the quarter. • Cash flows from operating activities was $180 million and operating cash flow before changes in working capital was $208 million or $0.71 per share. • Net income available to the Company was $22 million, or $0.08 per diluted share and adjusted net income available to the Company was $6 million or $0.02 per diluted share for the quarter. • Net income was $25 million and adjusted EBITDAX was $266 million. • $450 million Haynesville shale drilling venture with Jerry Jones is expected to generate free cash flow in the fourth quarter to further strengthen the balance sheet. • $1.65 billion SOCAR divestiture will substantially enhance Comstock's balance sheet. • Bank credit facility maturity was extended to November 15, 2028, and extends further to November 15, 2031, after the SOCAR transaction closes and debt is retired. Financial Results for the Three Months Ended September 30, 2026 Comstock produced 122.4 Bcfe in the third quarter of 2026, which increased 9% from the third quarter of 2025 and 8% from the second quarter of this year. During the third quarter of 2026, Comstock realized $2.61 per Mcfe before hedging and $2.94 per Mcfe after hedging. Comstock's natural gas and oil sales in the third quarter of 2026 were $359.3 million (including realized hedging gains of $39.5 million). Cash flows from operating activities in the third quarter of 2026 was $180.2 million. Operating cash flow before changes in working capital generated in the third quarter of 2026 was $208.0 million, and net income available to the Company for the third quarter was $22.3 million or $0.08 per diluted share. The net income available to the Company in the quarter included a pre-tax $35.1 million unrealized gain on hedging contracts held for price risk management resulting from the change in future natural gas prices since the second quarter of 2026. Excluding this item and exploration expense, adjusted net income available to the Company for the third quarter of 2026 was $5.9 million, or $0.02 per diluted share. Comstock's production cost per Mcfe in the third quarter averaged $0.80 per Mcfe, which was comprised of $0.41 for gathering and transportation costs, $0.23 for lease operating costs, $0.09 for production and other taxes and $0.07 for cash general and administrative expenses. Comstock's unhedged operating margin was 69% in the third quarter of 2026 and 73% after hedging. Financial Results for the Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026 For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, production was 1,221 MMcfe per day. Comstock realized $3.08 per Mcfe before hedging and $3.09 per Mcfe after hedging. Natural gas and oil sales for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 totaled $1.03 billion (including realized hedging gains of $2.4 million). Cash flows from operating activities for the first nine months of 2026 was $622.4 million. Operating cash flow before changes in working capital generated in the first nine months of 2026 was $588.4 million, and net income available to the Company was $138.5 million or $0.47 per diluted share. Net income available to the Company for the first nine months of 2026 included a pre-tax $118.9 million unrealized gain on hedging contracts held for price risk management. Excluding this item, exploration expense and gain on sale of assets, adjusted net income available to the Company for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was $53.6 million, or $0.18 per diluted share. Comstock's production cost per Mcfe for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 averaged $0.83 per Mcfe, which was comprised of $0.41 for gathering and transportation costs, $0.25 for lease operating costs, $0.09 for production and other taxes and $0.08 for cash general and administrative expenses. Comstock's unhedged and hedged operating margin was 73% for the first nine months of 2026. Drilling Results Comstock drilled 21 (13.9 net) operated horizontal Haynesville/Bossier shale wells in the third quarter of 2026, which had an average lateral length of 10,967 feet. Comstock turned 23 (20.4 net) operated wells to sales in the third quarter of 2026. Since its last operational update in July 2026, Comstock has turned 22 (17.1 net) operated Haynesville/Bossier shale wells to sales. These wells had initial production rates that averaged 27 MMcf per day. The completed lateral length of these wells averaged 10,544 feet. Included in the wells turned to sales were six more successful Western Haynesville wells: Well Vertical Depth (feet) Completed Lateral (feet) Initial Production Rate (MMcf per day) Kretzschmar PBH #1 18,274 7,956 29 Kretzschmar PP #1 16,572 9,292 39 Winn CR #1 14,970 11,393 31 Dollie Jones RP #1 16,322 14,783 40 Starkey MP #1 16,183 6,936 31 Danford CS #1 16,462 8,612 26 SOCAR Transaction On November 4, 2026, Comstock entered into a definitive purchase and sale agreement with the State Oil Company of the Republic of Azerbaijan ("SOCAR") to sell non-operated working interests in 20% of Comstock's interest in its Legacy Haynesville upstream assets, 15% of Comstock's interest in its Western Haynesville upstream assets and 15% of the Company's interest in Pinnacle Gas Services LLC for an aggregate cash purchase price of $1.65 billion, subject to customary purchase price adjustments. SOCAR's interest in the Western Haynesville upstream assets will reduce to 7.5% after five years and after SOCAR has achieved a 15% return on investment in those assets. The effective date of the transaction is July 1, 2026 and is expected to close by year end, subject to customary conditions, including any required governmental approvals. Extension of Bank Credit Facility On November 4, 2026, the Company entered into an amendment to its bank credit facility to extend the maturity date of the bank credit facility to November 15, 2028. Upon the closing of the SOCAR transaction and the retirement of debt using the proceeds received from SOCAR, the maturity date will extend further to November 15, 2031. After closing the SOCAR transaction, aggregate commitments under the bank credit facility will continue to be $1.5 billion while borrowings will be subject to a borrowing base initially set at $1.6 billion. (3) Adjusted EBITDAX is presented in the earnings release because management believes that adjusted EBITDAX, which represents Comstock's results from operations before interest, income taxes, and certain non-cash items, including depreciation, depletion and amortization, unrealized gains and losses on derivative financial instruments and exploration expense, is a common alternative measure of operating performance used by certain investors and financial analysts. (4) Operating cash flow before changes in working capital is presented in the earnings release because management believes it to be useful to investors as a measure of operating cash generation of the Company based on the revenues and expenses that were related to the period versus the period when the revenues were received or expenses paid while enhancing comparability across periods.
